title: Figure 10: Reliability Groups by Military vs. Civilian Observers, with Evaluations
description: Stacked bar chart of the percentage of all sightings in the Excellent, Good, Doubtful and Poor reliability groups, with each bar split into Military and Civilian observers. Above each bar, paired horizontal 0–100 percent bars show the evaluation breakdown (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown) for the military and civilian portions. Caption: "FIGURE 10 DISTRIBUTION OF ALL SIGHTINGS BY SIGHTING RELIABILITY GROUPS, SEGREGATED BY MILITARY AND CIVILIAN OBSERVERS WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH SEGREGATION"; drawing A-7488.
